mapper.select: select m.member_type, m.membership_type, m.auth_status, m.status, m.nickname, m.contact_name, m.contact_phone, m.service_phone, m.contact_email, m.alipay_real_name, m.alipay_account, m.store_logo_url, m.store_description, m.legal_subject_name, m.license_no, m.registered_capital, m.business_scope, m.license_address, date_format(m.license_valid_from, '%Y-%m-%d') as license_valid_from, date_format(m.license_valid_to, '%Y-%m-%d') as license_valid_to, m.license_long_term, m.legal_representative_name, case when m.wechat_qr_file_id is not null and m.wechat_qr_file_id > 0 then 1 else 0 end as wechat_qr_configured, m.vip_level, coalesce(nullif(ml.level_name, ''), '未设置') as vip_level_name, m.storage_quota_mb, m.external_accept_enabled from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m left join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_level` ml on ml.level_id = m.level_id and ml.is_delete = 0 where m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.is_delete = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` set nickname = #{nickname}, contact_name = #{contactName}, service_phone = #{servicePhone}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, alipay_real_name = #{alipayRealName}, alipay_account = #{alipayAccount}, store_description = #{storeDescription}, external_accept_enabled = #{externalAcceptEnabled}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0

update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` set store_logo_url = #{storeLogoUrl}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select setting_id, setting_key, setting_value_json, version from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member_setting` where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and setting_key = #{settingKey} and is_delete = 0 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member_setting` (tenant_id, member_id, setting_key, setting_value_json, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{settingKey}, #{settingValueJson}, 1, #{operator}, sysdate(), #{operator}, sysdate(), 0) on duplicate key update setting_value_json = values(setting_value_json), version = version + 1, update_by = values(update_by), update_time = sysdate(), is_delete = 0
